de1.P4.C4.ghi_chu: Anh cho mieng dat dai 2x + 10 (m) (image10), rong x (m) (image11), loi di rong 2 m (image13), don gia lat soi 120 nghin/m^2 (image16), dien tich hoa hong 45 m^2 (image17). Mau thuan ba phia: loi giai dung dien tich HCN 12x (khong khop 2x + 10) va viet dien tich loi di la 2x (suy ra hoa hong 5x) trong khi phuong an luu B (6x - x^2) lai ung voi dien tich loi di 2x^2. Y b cung khong khop: voi phuong an B thi 6x - x^2 = 45 vo nghiem; voi loi giai (hoa 5x) thi x = 9, loi di 18 m^2, chi phi 2160 nghin (khong phai 2000). Can hinh va de goc.
